characters.name: Nobita Nobi
characters.description: Kind-hearted, imaginative and often rescued from trouble by Doraemon's gadgets.

characters.name: Shizuka Minamoto
characters.description: Smart, caring and one of the most important people in Nobita's life.

characters.name: Gian
characters.description: Strong and confident, with a legendary love of singing.

characters.name: Suneo Honekawa
characters.description: Stylish and boastful, often showing off his family's possessions.

characters.name: Dorami
characters.description: A capable yellow robot cat who often helps when Doraemon needs support.

gadgets.description: Doraemon's famous pocket stores an enormous collection of gadgets.

gadgets.name: Time Machine
gadgets.description: Allows journeys across different points in time.

facts: Doraemon is a robotic cat from the future.
Dorayaki is strongly associated with Doraemon.
Nobita is Doraemon's primary companion in the 20th century.
The series combines comedy, friendship, imagination and futuristic technology.
